title: Adi-khanda, part 10 (portion 18)
html:
The beginning of the Kaishora-lila: preparations for Vishvambhara's wedding; the adhivasa of bridegroom and bride; the women of Nadia go to fetch water for the rite; the wedding morning — the nandimukha-shraddha, the tears of Shachi and of the Lord for His departed father; the bridegroom's attire and the wedding procession, the rejoicing of Nadia

Kaishora-lila (The Pastimes of Youth): the Wedding

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. One day, as Gaurasundara, having finished His lessons, was returning home from His teacher's house, He met Vanamali Acharya on the way. Talking with the Acharya, Gaurahari understood that he had gone to His mother Shachi-devi to arrange His marriage, but, not having received the hoped-for answer from Shachi-devi, was returning home with a saddened heart. Without saying a word to the Acharya on the way, Gaurahari went home and by a hint let Mother Shachi know His wish; then Mother Shachi again summoned the matchmaker Vanamali Acharya and told him to arrange her son's marriage. Receiving Mother Shachi's command, Vanamali Acharya came to the house of Vallabhacharya and settled the marriage of Gaurahari with his daughter Lakshmi-devi. When the marriage had been agreed upon, Shachi-devi called her relatives and neighbours and announced her son's wedding, and all were immersed in an ocean of supreme bliss. Meanwhile Shachi-devi set about making all kinds of preparations in the house for her son's wedding. Before long the day of the adhivasa arrived. The respectable ladies, following ancient popular custom, duly performed the anointing of the body with turmeric, the fetching of water1 and other rites; the Vedic rites too were performed as prescribed. In Vallabhacharya's house all these rites were likewise duly performed. Then on the wedding day Gaurahari, with great pomp, in a festive procession and with many companions, arrived at the house of Vallabhacharya, and the Acharya, according to ancient custom, received his son-in-law by offering Him water for His feet and arghya. Then the Acharya brought his daughter Lakshmi-devi to the wedding pavilion and gave her to Gaurahari. And after completing the rites of kushandika,2 the feeding of brahmanas and so on, he sent his daughter to his son-in-law's house.

Raga varadi; disha: "Dvijachand is my life!"

তবে শচী নিজসুত-বদন চাহিয়া ।
মধুর-বচনে কিছু কহে ত হাসিয়া ॥ ১ ॥

tabe śacī nijasuta-badana cāhiẏā |
madhura-bacane kichu kahe ta hāsiẏā || 1 ||

tabe — then; shachi — Shachi; nija-suta-badana chahiya — looking at her son's face; madhura-bachane — with sweet words; kichhu kahe ta hasiya — speaks smiling

1Then Shachi, looking at her son's face,
says to Him sweet words with a smile:

শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর মোর সোণার সুত ।
বল্লভ-আচার্য-কন্যা অতি অদভুত ॥ ২ ॥

śuna śuna biśbambhara mora soṇāra suta |
ballabha-ācārya-kanyā ati adabhuta || 2 ||

shuna shuna — listen, listen; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; mora sonara suta — my golden son; vallabha-acharya-kanya — Vallabha Acharya's daughter; ati adabhuta — simply wonderful

2"Listen, listen, Vishvambhara, my golden son:
the daughter of Vallabha Acharya is simply wonderful.

তোর বিবাহের যোগ্য মোর মনে লয় ।
হেন পুত্রবধূ মোর কত ভাগ্যে হয় ॥ ৩ ॥

tora bibāhera yogya mora mane laẏa |
hena putrabadhū mora kata bhāgye haẏa || 3 ||

tora vibahera yogya — worthy of marriage with You; mora mane laya — so I feel; hena putra-badhu mora — such a daughter-in-law for me; kata bhagye haya — by what good fortune

3I feel she is worthy to be Your wife;
what good fortune to have such a daughter-in-law!

বিচার করিয়া কর বিচিত্র সময় ।
দ্রব্য আহরণ কর যে উচিত হয় ॥ ৪ ॥

bicāra kariẏā kara bicitra samaẏa |
drabya āharaṇa kara ye ucita haẏa || 4 ||

vichara kariya — considering; kara vichitra samaya — fix a splendid time; dravya aharana kara — gather the things; ye uchita haya — that are proper

4Consider it and fix a splendid time;
gather all that is proper."

শুনিঞা মায়ের বাণী বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
করিল সকল দ্রব্য যতেক যুয়ায় ॥ ৫ ॥

śuniñā māẏera bāṇī biśbambhara rāẏa |
karila sakala drabya yateka yuẏāẏa || 5 ||

shunina mayera vani — hearing His mother's words; vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya; karila sakala dravya — got ready everything; yateka yuyaya — that was needed

5Hearing His mother's words, Vishvambhara Raya
got ready all that was needed.

দৈবজ্ঞ আনিল আর উত্তম পণ্ডিত ।
করিল ত শুভক্ষণ সময় অঙ্কিত ॥ ৬ ॥

daibajña ānila āra uttama paṇḍita |
karila ta śubhakṣaṇa samaẏa aṅkita || 6 ||

daivajna anila — called an astrologer; ara uttama pandita — and an excellent pandit; karila ta — they fixed; shubha-kshana samaya ankita — the auspicious moment and time

6He called an astrologer and an excellent pandit,
and they fixed the auspicious moment and time.

সেই শুভদিন শুভসময় হইল ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন সব আনন্দে আইল ॥ ৭ ॥

sei śubhadina śubhasamaẏa haila |
brāhmaṇa-sajjana saba ānande āila || 7 ||

sei shubhadina — that auspicious day; shubha-samaya haila — the auspicious time came; brahmana-sajjana saba — brahmanas and all good people; anande aila — came joyfully

7That auspicious day, that auspicious time arrived;
brahmanas and all good people came joyfully.

আনন্দে ভরল সব নদীয়া-নগরী ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু আপনা পাসরি ॥ ৮ ॥

ānande bharala saba nadīẏā-nagarī |
uthalila premasindhu āpanā pāsari || 8 ||

anande bharala — was filled with joy; saba nadiya-nagari — the whole town of Nadia; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surged; apana pasari — forgetting themselves

8The whole town of Nadia was filled with joy;
the ocean of prema surged, and all forgot themselves.

আইহ-সুহ লঞা শচী করে শুভকার্য ।
প্রভু-অধিবাস করে সকল আচার্য ॥ ৯ ॥

āiha-suha lañā śacī kare śubhakārya |
prabhu-adhibāsa kare sakala ācārya || 9 ||

aiha-suha lana — with the married women; shachi kare shubha-karya — Shachi performs the auspicious rites; prabhu-adhivasa kare — perform the Lord's adhivasa; sakala acharya — all the acharyas

9Gathering the married women,3 Shachi performs the auspicious rites;
all the acharyas perform the Lord's adhivasa.

চতুর্দিকে বেদধ্বনি করয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ।
শঙ্খ মৃদঙ্গ বাজে মঙ্গল লক্ষণ ॥ ১০ ॥

caturdike bedadhbani karaẏe brāhmaṇa |
śaṅkha mṛdaṅga bāje maṅgala lakṣaṇa || 10 ||

chaturdike — on all sides; veda-dhvani karaye brahmana — brahmanas recite the Vedas; shankha mridanga baje — conchs and mridangas sound; mangala lakshana — auspicious signs

10On all sides the brahmanas recite the Vedas;
conchs and mridangas sound — auspicious signs.

দীপ-মালা-পতাকা-ভূষিত দিগন্তরে ।
সুগন্ধি-চন্দন মালা অতি মনোহরে ॥ ১১ ॥

dīpa-mālā-patākā-bhūṣita digantare |
sugandhi-candana mālā ati manohare || 11 ||

dipa-mala-pataka-bhushita — adorned with rows of lamps and flags; digantare — the quarters; sugandhi-chandana mala — fragrant sandal, garlands; ati manohare — most beautiful

11All the quarters are adorned with rows of lamps and flags;
fragrant sandal, garlands — everything is beautiful.

সকল ব্রাহ্মণে প্রভুর কৈল অধিবাস ।
কোটি-কামরূপ দেহ কৈল পরকাশ ॥ ১২ ॥

sakala brāhmaṇe prabhura kaila adhibāsa |
koṭi-kāmarūpa deha kaila parakāśa || 12 ||

sakala brahmane — all the brahmanas; prabhura kaila adhivasa — performed the Lord's adhivasa; koti-kama-rupa deha — a body beautiful as millions of Kamas; kaila parakasha — He revealed

12All the brahmanas performed the Lord's adhivasa,
and He revealed a body as beautiful as millions of Kamadevas.

ঝলমল করে অঙ্গ-ছটা আলোকিত ।
দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণ সব ভেল চমকিত ॥ ১৩ ॥

jhalamala kare aṅga-chaṭā ālokita |
dekhiẏā brāhmaṇa saba bhela camakita || 13 ||

jhalamala kare — sparkles; anga-chhata alokita — all lit by the radiance of His body; dekhiya — seeing; brahmana saba — all the brahmanas; bhela chamakita — were amazed

13His body sparkles, all is lit by its radiance;
seeing it, all the brahmanas were amazed.

সুগন্ধি-চন্দন মালা ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল ।
ঘন ঘন তাম্বূল-দানে বড় তুষ্ট কৈল ॥ ১৪ ॥

sugandhi-candana mālā brāhmaṇere dila |
ghana ghana tāmbūla-dāne baṛa tuṣṭa kaila || 14 ||

sugandhi-chandana mala — fragrant sandal, garlands; brahmanere dila — were given to the brahmanas; ghana ghana tambula-dane — with repeated gifts of betel; bada tushta kaila — pleased them greatly

14The brahmanas were given fragrant sandal and garlands
and, with gift after gift of betel, were greatly pleased.

কন্যা অধিবাস করে বল্লভ-আচার্য ।
সুমঙ্গল কর্ম কৈল লঞা দ্বিজবর্য ॥ ১৫ ॥

kanyā adhibāsa kare ballabha-ācārya |
sumaṅgala karma kaila lañā dbijabarya || 15 ||

kanya adhivasa kare — performs the bride's adhivasa; vallabha-acharya — Vallabha Acharya; sumangala karma kaila — performed the auspicious rites; lana dvijavarya — with the best of brahmanas

15Vallabha Acharya performs the bride's adhivasa;
with the best of brahmanas he performed the auspicious rites.

অন্যোন্যে সৌরভ্য গন্ধ-মাল্য-চন্দন ।
অধিবাসে ভূষা কৈল জামাতা-রতন ॥ ১৬ ॥

anyonye saurabhya gandha-mālya-candana |
adhibāse bhūṣā kaila jāmātā-ratana || 16 ||

anyonye — mutually; saurabhya gandha-malya-chandana — fragrant scents, garlands, sandal; adhivase — at the adhivasa; bhusha kaila — adorned; jamata-ratana — the jewel of a son-in-law

16Exchanging fragrant garlands, sandal and scents,
at the adhivasa they adorned the jewel of a son-in-law.

অধিবাস-সমাধান রজনীর শেষে ।
পানী সাহিব বলি আইল উল্লাসে ॥ ১৭ ॥

adhibāsa-samādhāna rajanīra śeṣe |
pānī sāhiba bali āila ullāse || 17 ||

adhivasa-samadhana — the completion of the adhivasa; rajanira sheshe — at the end of the night; pani sahiba bali — saying "we shall fetch the water" (for the rite); aila ullase — came rejoicing

17When the adhivasa was finished towards the end of the night,
[the women] came rejoicing, saying: "Let us go for the water!"4

নানা বাদ্য এককালে হইল তরঙ্গ ।
কুলবতী সভাকার ব্রত কৈল ভঙ্গ ॥ ১৮ ॥

nānā bādya ekakāle haila taraṅga |
kulabatī sabhākāra brata kaila bhaṅga || 18 ||

nana vadya — all kinds of instruments; eka-kale — at once; haila taranga — rose in waves; kulavati sabhakara — of all the respectable wives; vrata kaila bhanga — broke the vows

18All at once, in waves, all kinds of instruments sounded,
and all the respectable wives forgot their vows.

যুবতী উমতী হৈল নদীয়া-নগরে ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-বিবাহ-রস-সমুদ্র-হিল্লোলে ॥ ১৯ ॥

yubatī umatī haila nadīẏā-nagare |
gaurāṅga-bibāha-rasa-samudra-hillole || 19 ||

yuvati — the young women; umati haila — lost their senses; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; gauranga-vibaha-rasa-samudra-hillole — in the waves of the ocean of rasa of Gauranga's wedding

19The young women in the town of Nadia lost their senses
in the waves of the ocean of rasa of Gauranga's wedding.5

যূথে যূথে নাগরী চলিল বিপ্রবধূ ।
অবনী-মণ্ডলেরে মণ্ডিত যেন বিধু ॥ ২০ ॥

yūthe yūthe nāgarī calila biprabadhū |
abanī-maṇḍalere maṇḍita yena bidhu || 20 ||

yuthe yuthe — in throngs; nagari chalila — the nagaris went; vipra-badhu — wives of brahmanas; avani-mandalere mandita — adorning the circle of the earth; yena vidhu — like moons

20In throngs go the nagaris — wives of brahmanas —
like moons adorning the circle of the earth.

কুরঙ্গ-নয়নী চারু কুঞ্জর-গামিনী ।
ঝলমল অঙ্গতেজ মদন-দাপুনী ॥ ২১ ॥

kuraṅga-naẏanī cāru kuñjara-gāminī |
jhalamala aṅgateja madana-dāpunī || 21 ||

kuranga-nayani — doe-eyed; charu kunjara-gamini — with the lovely gait of a she-elephant; jhalamala anga-teja — their bodies' radiance sparkles; madana-dapuni — humbling Madana's pride

21Eyes like a doe's, gait like a she-elephant's,
the radiance of their bodies sparkles, humbling Madana's pride.

কেশ-বেশ-বসন-ভূষণ অনুপাম ।
হেরিলে হরিতে পারে মুনির পরাণ ॥ ২২ ॥

keśa-beśa-basana-bhūṣaṇa anupāma |
herile harite pāre munira parāṇa || 22 ||

kesha-besha-basana-bhushana — hair, dress, garments, ornaments; anupama — matchless; herile — on seeing; harite pare — can steal; munira parana — a sage's heart

22Their hair, dress, garments and ornaments are matchless:
one glance at them would steal even a sage's heart.

হাসিতে দামিনী কাঁপে বচনে অমিয়া ।
হাস-পরিহাসে চলে ঢুলিয়া ঢুলিয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

hāsite dāminī kāṁpe bacane amiẏā |
hāsa-parihāse cale ḍhuliẏā ḍhuliẏā || 23 ||

hasite — in the smile; damini kanpe — lightning trembles; bachane amiya — nectar in speech; hasa-parihase — laughing and jesting; chale dhuliya dhuliya — they go swaying

23In their smiles lightning trembles, in their speech is nectar;
laughing and jesting, they go swaying along.

গাইছে গৌরাঙ্গগুণ মধুর-আলাপে ।
স্বর-পঞ্চ-ধ্বনিতে অনঙ্গ-অঙ্গ কাঁপে ॥ ২৪ ॥

gāiche gaurāṅgaguṇa madhura-ālāpe |
sbara-pañca-dhbanite anaṅga-aṅga kāṁpe || 24 ||

gaichhe gauranga-guna — they sing Gauranga's virtues; madhura-alape — in sweet melodies; svara-pancha-dhvanite — at the sound of the fifth note; ananga-anga kanpe — Ananga's body trembles

24They sing of Gauranga's virtues in sweet melodies;
at the sound of the fifth note Ananga's body trembles.

নাসায় বেশর শোভে মুকুতা-হিল্লোলে ।
নক্ষত্র পড়িছে যেন অরুণ-মণ্ডলে ॥ ২৫ ॥

nāsāẏa beśara śobhe mukutā-hillole |
nakṣatra paṛiche yena aruṇa-maṇḍale || 25 ||

nasaya beshara shobhe — nose-rings shine; mukuta-hillole — with swaying pearls; nakshatra padichhe — stars are falling; yena — as if; aruna-mandale — onto the red disc [of dawn]

25In their noses pearl-rings sway —
as if stars were falling onto the red disc [of dawn].

শচীর মন্দিরে আইলা কুলবধূগণ ।
সভাকারে দিলা গন্ধ গুবাক চন্দন ॥ ২৬ ॥

śacīra mandire āilā kulabadhūgaṇa |
sabhākāre dilā gandha gubāka candana || 26 ||

shachira mandire — to Shachi's house; aila kulabadhu-gana — the respectable wives came; sabhakare dila — to all were given; gandha guvaka chandana — scents, betel nuts and sandal

26The respectable wives came to Shachi's house;
all were given scents, betel nuts and sandal.

চলিলা নাগরী সভে পানী সাহিবারে ।
মঙ্গল আনন্দরস প্রতি ঘরে ঘরে ॥ ২৭ ॥

calilā nāgarī sabhe pānī sāhibāre |
maṅgala ānandarasa prati ghare ghare || 27 ||

chalila nagari sabhe — all the nagaris went; pani sahibare — to fetch the water; mangala ananda-rasa — auspicious joy; prati ghare ghare — in every house

27All the nagaris went for the water;
in every house there is auspicious joy.

Sung in raga tudi

সচন্দ্রিম রজনী চন্দ্রমুখী বালা ।
সুস্বর সঙ্গীত গো গাইব গোরালীলা ॥ ২৮ ॥

sacandrima rajanī candramukhī bālā |
susbara saṅgīta go gāiba gorālīlā || 28 ||

sachandrima rajani — a moonlit night; chandramukhi bala — moon-faced maidens; susvara sangita — with sweet voices; go — friends; gaiba gora-lila — we shall sing Gora's lilas

28A moonlit night, moon-faced maidens;
with sweet voices, friends, we shall sing of Gora's lilas.

Refrain: "Who, who will go in front, friends, who will sing of Gora's virtues, friends? Let us go for the water! The heart surges — who can hold it back?"

কেহ পট্টবিলাসিনী কেহ পীতবাসে ।
ঢুলিতে ঢুলিতে যায় গোরা-অঙ্গের বাতাসে ॥ ২৯ ॥

keha paṭṭabilāsinī keha pītabāse |
ḍhulite ḍhulite yāẏa gorā-aṅgera bātāse || 29 ||

keha pattavilasini — one in silken dress; keha pita-vase — another in yellow garments; dhulite dhulite yaya — they go swaying; gora-angera batase — [fanned by] the breeze from Gora's body

29One in silken dress, another in yellow garments;
swaying, they go [fanned by] the breeze from Gora's body.

শচী আগে আগে করি যাব পাছে পাছে ।
আসিতে যাইতে গো দাঁড়াব গোরা-কাছে ॥ ৩০ ॥

śacī āge āge kari yāba pāche pāche |
āsite yāite go dāṁṛāba gorā-kāche || 30 ||

shachi age age kari — putting Shachi in front; yaba pachhe pachhe — we shall go behind; asite yaite — coming and going; go — friends; dandaba gora-kachhe — we shall stand near Gora

30"Let Shachi go in front, and we shall go behind her;
coming and going, friends, we shall stand near Gora.

সুগন্ধি-চন্দন মালা ঢাকি লহ করে ।
গোরা-অঙ্গ পরশ করিব সেহি ছলে ॥ ৩১ ॥

sugandhi-candana mālā ḍhāki laha kare |
gorā-aṅga paraśa kariba sehi chale || 31 ||

sugandhi-chandana mala — fragrant sandal and garlands; dhaki laha kare — take in your hands, covered; gora-anga parasha kariba — I shall touch Gora's body; sehi chhale — on that pretext

31Take fragrant sandal and garlands in your hands, covered:
on that pretext I shall touch Gora's body.

কর্পূর তাম্বূল লেহ যত্ন করি হাথে ।
করে কর ধরি গোরার দিব হাথে হাথে ॥ ৩২ ॥

karpūra tāmbūla leha yatna kari hāthe |
kare kara dhari gorāra diba hāthe hāthe || 32 ||

karpura tambula — camphor and betel; leha yatna kari hathe — take carefully in your hands; kare kara dhari — hand in hand; gorara diba hathe hathe — I shall place right into Gora's hand

32Take camphor and betel carefully in your hands;
hand in hand, I shall place them right into Gora's hand."

আইহ-সুহ মিলিয়া কৌতুক-রঙ্গ-রসে ।
পানী সাহিল গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

āiha-suha miliẏā kautuka-raṅga-rase |
pānī sāhila guṇa gāẏa e locanadāse || 33 ||

aiha-suha miliya — the married women together; kautuka-ranga-rase — in play and merriment; pani sahila — fetched the water; guna gaya — sings the virtues; e lochana-dase — this Lochana Dasa

33The married women, gathered together in play and merriment,
brought the water — so sings this Lochana Dasa of [the Lord's] virtues.

Raga bhatiyari

আনন্দে সানন্দে রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে ।
যথাবিধি কর্ম কৈল হরষিত-চিতে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

ānande sānande rātri suprabhāte |
yathābidhi karma kaila haraṣita-cite || 34 ||

anande sanande — in joy and gladness; ratri — the night [passed]; suprabhate — at the bright dawn; yathavidhi karma kaila — performed the rites by rule; harashita-chite — with joyful hearts

34In joy and gladness the night passed; at the bright dawn
with joyful hearts they performed the rites according to rule.

স্নান-দান কর্ম কৈল যে ছিল উচিত ।
দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা করিল বিহিত ॥ ৩৫ ॥

snāna-dāna karma kaila ye chila ucita |
debapūjā pitṛpūjā karila bihita || 35 ||

snana-dana karma kaila — performed bathing and gift-giving; ye chhila uchita — as was proper; deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; karila vihita — performed as prescribed

35They performed the bathing and the giving of gifts, as was proper;
as prescribed, they worshipped the gods and the ancestors.

নান্দীমুখ-শ্রাদ্ধ কৈল যে বেদবিধান ।
সর্ব সম্পূর্ণ ভোজ্য ব্রাহ্মণেরে দান ॥ ৩৬ ॥

nāndīmukha-śrāddha kaila ye bedabidhāna |
sarba sampūrṇa bhojya brāhmaṇere dāna || 36 ||

nandimukha-shraddha kaila — performed the nandimukha-shraddha; ye veda-vidhana — as the Vedas ordain; sarva sampurna bhojya — abundant food; brahmanere dana — given to the brahmanas

36They performed the nandimukha-shraddha as the Vedas ordain;
abundant food was given to the brahmanas.

নর্তকেরে দিল দ্রব্য আর ভাটগণে ।
সভার সন্তোষ কৈল নানা দ্রব্যদানে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

nartakere dila drabya āra bhāṭagaṇe |
sabhāra santoṣa kaila nānā drabyadāne || 37 ||

nartakere dila dravya — gifts were given to dancers; ara bhatagane — and to the bards; sabhara santosha kaila — all were pleased; nana dravya-dane — with gifts of every kind

37To dancers and to the bards gifts were given;
with gifts of every kind all were pleased.

দ্রব্যকে অধিক মানে মধুর বচনে ।
দেখিয়া যুড়ায় হিয়া চন্দ্রিম-বদনে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

drabyake adhika māne madhura bacane |
dekhiẏā yuṛāẏa hiẏā candrima-badane || 38 ||

dravyake adhika mane — they value more than the gifts; madhura bachane — the sweet words; dekhiya — seeing; yudaya hiya — the heart is refreshed; chandrima-badane — the moonlike face

38But they valued [the Lord's] sweet words more than the gifts:
seeing His moonlike face, the heart is refreshed.

প্রবোধ করিল যার যেই অনুমান ।
বিবাহ-উচিত প্রভু করে পুনঃ স্নান ॥ ৩৯ ॥

prabodha karila yāra yei anumāna |
bibāha-ucita prabhu kare punaḥ snāna || 39 ||

prabodha karila — satisfied; yara yei anumana — each according to his hope; vibaha-uchita — as befits the wedding; prabhu kare punah snana — the Lord bathes again

39He satisfied each one as he had hoped;
then the Lord bathes again, as befits the wedding.

নাপিতে নাপিত-ক্রিয়া করিল সেকালে ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ-মার্জনা করে কুলবধূ মেলে ॥ ৪০ ॥

nāpite nāpita-kriẏā karila sekāle |
śrīaṅga-mārjanā kare kulabadhū mele || 40 ||

napite — the barber; napita-kriya karila — did his work; se-kale — then; sri-anga-marjana kare — anoint the divine body; kulabadhu mele — the respectable wives together

40Then the barber did his work,
and the respectable wives together anoint His divine body.

সুধাকরময় গোরা রূপের পাথার ।
ডুবিল তরুণীর মন না জানে সাঁতার ॥ ৪০+১ ॥

sudhākaramaẏa gorā rūpera pāthāra |
ḍubila taruṇīra mana nā jāne sāṁtāra || 40+1 ||

sudhakaramaya — made of moon-nectar; gora — Gora; rupera pathara — an ocean of beauty; dubila — sank; tarunira mana — the minds (hearts) of the young women; na jane santara — know not how to swim

40+1Gora is an ocean of beauty woven of moonlit nectar;
the hearts of the young women sank in it — they do not know how to swim.6

পরশে অবশ অঙ্গ হইল সবাকার ।
গদগদ বচন নয়নে জলধার ॥ ৪০+২ ॥

paraśe abaśa aṅga haila sabākāra |
gadagada bacana naẏane jaladhāra || 40+2 ||

parashe — at the touch; avasha anga haila — the body grew faint; sabakara — of all; gadgada vachana — faltering speech; nayane jaladhara — streams of tears from the eyes

40+2At touching Him the bodies of all grew faint;
their speech falters, streams of tears flow from their eyes.

হেরইতে পহু-মুখ কি ভাব উঠিল ।
মরমে মদন-জ্বরে ঢলিয়া পড়িল ॥ ৪০+৩ ॥

heraite pahu-mukha ki bhāba uṭhila |
marame madana-jbare ḍhaliẏā paṛila || 40+3 ||

heraite — on beholding; pahu-mukha — the Lord's face; ki bhava uthila — what feeling arose; marame — deep in the heart; madana-jvare — with the fever of Madana; dhaliya padila — sank down powerless

40+3On beholding the Lord's face — what feeling rose in them! —
burning deep in their hearts with the fever of Madana, they sank down powerless.

কেহো বাহু ধরি রহে অথির হইয়া ।
কেহো রহে উদ্বর্তন শ্রীঅঙ্গে লেপিয়া ॥ ৪০+৪ ॥

keho bāhu dhari rahe athira haiẏā |
keho rahe udbartana śrīaṅge lepiẏā || 40+4 ||

keho — one; bahu dhari — holding [His] arm; rahe athira haiya — stands trembling; keho rahe — another stays; udvartana — fragrant paste; sri-ange lepiya — rubbing [it] on the divine body

40+4One, holding His arm, stands all atremble;
another stays still, rubbing His divine body with fragrant paste.

কেহো বুকে পদযুগ ধরিয়া আনন্দে ।
ভুজলতা দিয়া সে বান্ধিল পরবন্ধে ॥ ৪০+৫ ॥

keho buke padayuga dhariẏā ānande |
bhujalatā diẏā se bāndhila parabandhe || 40+5 ||

keho — one; buke — to the breast; padayuga dhariya — clasping the two feet; anande — in bliss; bhujalata diya — with the creepers of her arms; se bandhila — she bound; parabandhe — fast

40+5One in bliss pressed His two feet to her breast
and bound them fast with the creepers of her arms.

কেহো চিত্রার্পিত হৈয়া নেহারে গৌরাঙ্গ ।
কেহো জল দেই শিরে মদন-তরঙ্গে ॥ ৪০+৬ ॥

keho citrārpita haiẏā nehāre gaurāṅga |
keho jala dei śire madana-taraṅge || 40+6 ||

keho — one; chitrarpita haiya — as if painted in a picture; nehare gauranga — gazes at Gauranga; keho — another; jala dei shire — pours water on the head; madana-tarange — in the waves of Madana

40+6One, as if painted in a picture, gazes fixedly at Gauranga;
another, in the waves of Madana, pours water on His head.

উন্মত্ত হইয়া কেহো হাসে ঘনে ঘনে ।
সতীত্ব নাশিল হেরি গৌরাঙ্গ-বদনে ॥ ৪০+৭ ॥

unmatta haiẏā keho hāse ghane ghane |
satītba nāśila heri gaurāṅga-badane || 40+7 ||

unmatta haiya — as if mad; keho hase — one laughs; ghane ghane — again and again; satitva nashila — lost [the duty of] a faithful wife; heri — seeing; gauranga-vadane — Gauranga's face

40+7One, as if mad, laughs again and again:
seeing Gauranga's face, they forgot even the duty of a faithful wife.

অভিষেক কৈল প্রভুর সুরনদী-জলে ।
দেখি সর্বজন ভাসে আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ৪০+৮ ॥

abhiṣeka kaila prabhura suranadī-jale |
dekhi sarbajana bhāse ānanda-hillole || 40+8 ||

abhisheka kaila — bathed; prabhura — the Lord; suranadi-jale — with the water of the celestial river; dekhi — seeing; sarvajana — all people; bhase — float; ananda-hillole — on waves of bliss

40+8They bathed the Lord with the water of the celestial river;
seeing this, all the people rocked on waves of bliss.

স্নান সমাধিয়া যবে বসিলা আসনে ।
বেঢ়িল নাগরীগণ শচীর নন্দনে ॥ ৪০+৯ ॥

snāna samādhiẏā yabe basilā āsane |
beṛhila nāgarīgaṇa śacīra nandane || 40+9 ||

snana samadhiya — having completed the bath; yabe basila asane — when He sat on the seat; bedhila — surrounded; nagari-gana — the nagaris; shachira nandane — the son of Shachi

40+9When, His bath completed, He sat down on His seat,
the nagaris surrounded the son of Shachi.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে সুমধুর ধ্বনি ।
চতুর্দিকে হুলাহুলি জয় জয় শুনি ॥ ৪১ ॥

nānābidha bādya bāje sumadhura dhbani |
caturdike hulāhuli jaẏa jaẏa śuni || 41 ||

nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments sound; sumadhura dhvani — sweet tones; chaturdike — on all sides; hulahuli — "ulu-ulu" cries; jaya jaya shuni — "Jaya, jaya!" is heard

41All kinds of instruments sound with sweet tones;
on all sides the cries of "ulu-ulu" and "Jaya, jaya!" are heard.

তবে শচীদেবী লই আইহ-সুহ যত ।
আদরে পূজয়ে যার যেই সমুচিত ॥ ৪২ ॥

tabe śacīdebī lai āiha-suha yata |
ādare pūjaẏe yāra yei samucita || 42 ||

tabe shachidevi — then Shachi-devi; lai aiha-suha yata — taking all the married women; adare pujaye — lovingly honours; yara yei samuchita — each as befits her

42Then Shachi-devi, taking with her all the married women,
lovingly honours each as befits her.

সভারে পূজিলা গৃহাগত বন্ধু যত ।
বলিল সভারে শচী হৃদয় বেকত ॥ ৪৩ ॥

sabhāre pūjilā gṛhāgata bandhu yata |
balila sabhāre śacī hṛdaẏa bekata || 43 ||

sabhare pujila — honoured all; griha-agata bandhu yata — all the kin who had come to the house; balila sabhare shachi — Shachi said to all; hridaya bekata — opening her heart

43She honoured all the kinsfolk who had come to the house
and spoke to all, opening her heart:

পতিহীন মুঞি ছার পুত্র পিতৃহীন ।
তো সভার পূজা কি করিব আমি দীন ॥ ৪৪ ॥

patihīna muñi chāra putra pitṛhīna |
to sabhāra pūjā ki kariba āmi dīna || 44 ||

patihina muni chhara — I, wretched, without a husband; putra pitrihina — my son fatherless; to sabhara puja — honouring you; ki kariba ami dina — how shall I, poor one, do it

44"I, wretched one, have lost my husband, my son is fatherless;
how can I, poor as I am, honour you?"7

এ বোল বলিতে শচী গদগদ-ভাষ ।
ভিজিল আঁখির জলে হৃদয়ের বাস ॥ ৪৫ ॥

e bola balite śacī gadagada-bhāṣa |
bhijila āṁkhira jale hṛdaẏera bāsa || 45 ||

e bola balite — saying this; shachi gadagada-bhasha — Shachi's speech faltered; bhijila ankhira jale — was soaked with the tears of her eyes; hridayera basa — the garment over her breast

45As she said this, Shachi's voice faltered;
tears from her eyes soaked the garment over her breast.

এছন কাতর-বাণী শচী যবে বৈল ।
শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ হেট মাথা কৈল ॥ ৪৬ ॥

echana kātara-bāṇī śacī yabe baila |
śuni biśbambhara pahuṁ heṭa māthā kaila || 46 ||

echhana katara-vani — such grieving words; shachi yabe baila — when Shachi spoke; shuni — hearing; vishvambhara pahun — the Lord Vishvambhara; heta matha kaila — bowed His head

46When Shachi spoke these grieving words,
the Lord Vishvambhara, hearing them, bowed His head.

চিন্তিতে লাগিলা মোর পিতা গেলা কোথা ।
পুড়িতে লাগিল হিয়া পাইল বড় ব্যথা ॥ ৪৭ ॥

cintite lāgilā mora pitā gelā kothā |
puṛite lāgila hiẏā pāila baṛa byathā || 47 ||

chintite lagila — He began to think; mora pita gela kotha — where has My father gone; pudite lagila hiya — His heart began to burn; paila bada vyatha — He felt great pain

47He began to think: "Where has My father gone?"
His heart began to burn; He felt great pain.

মুকুতা-গাঁথনী যেন চক্ষে পড়ে পানী ।
দেখিয়া ত্রস্ত হৈলা দেবী শচীরাণী ॥ ৪৮ ॥

mukutā-gāṁthanī yena cakṣe paṛe pānī |
dekhiẏā trasta hailā debī śacīrāṇī || 48 ||

mukuta-ganthani yena — like a string of pearls; chakshe pade pani — tears fall from the eyes; dekhiya — seeing; trasta haila — was alarmed; devi shachirani — the goddess Shachi-rani

48Tears fall from His eyes like a string of pearls;
seeing this, the goddess Shachi-rani was alarmed.

আর যত কুলবধূ তার পাশে ছিল ।
প্রভুর কান্দনা দেখি কান্দিতে লাগিল ॥ ৪৯ ॥

āra yata kulabadhū tāra pāśe chila |
prabhura kāndanā dekhi kāndite lāgila || 49 ||

ara yata kulabadhu — and all the respectable wives; tara pashe chhila — who were beside her; prabhura kandana dekhi — seeing the Lord weep; kandite lagila — began to weep

49And all the respectable wives who were beside her,
seeing the Lord's tears, began to weep.

কেনে কেনে বাপ হেরি নিরস-বদন ।
এহেন মঙ্গলকার্যে করহ ক্রন্দন ॥ ৫০ ॥

kene kene bāpa heri nirasa-badana |
ehena maṅgalakārye karaha krandana || 50 ||

kene kene — why, why; bapa — child; heri nirasa-badana — do I see Your face so sad; ehena mangala-karye — at such an auspicious event; karaha krandana — You weep

50"Why, why, child, do I see Your face so sad?
At such an auspicious time — and You weep?

সকল সংসারে মোর তুমি মাত্র ধন ।
তুমি বিমরিষ প্রাণ ছাড়িব এখন ॥ ৫১ ॥

sakala saṃsāre mora tumi mātra dhana |
tumi bimariṣa prāṇa chāṛiba ekhana || 51 ||

sakala samsare — in all the world; mora tumi matra dhana — You are my only wealth; tumi vimarisha — [if] You are dejected; prana chhadiba ekhana — I shall give up my life now

51In all the world You are my only wealth;
if You are dejected, I shall give up my life this very moment."

শুনিঞা মায়ের বাণী প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বাপের হুতাশে কণ্ঠ গদগদ-স্বর ॥ ৫২ ॥

śuniñā māẏera bāṇī prabhu biśbambhara |
bāpera hutāśe kaṇṭha gadagada-sbara || 52 ||

shunina mayera vani — hearing His mother's words; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; bapera hutashe — in grief for His father; kantha gadagada-svara — with faltering voice

52Hearing His mother's words, the Lord Vishvambhara,
grieving for His father, speaks in a faltering voice.

প্রাতঃকালে শশী যেন মলিন-বদন ।
নবীন-মেঘের যেন গম্ভীর গর্জন ॥ ৫৩ ॥

prātaḥkāle śaśī yena malina-badana |
nabīna-meghera yena gambhīra garjana || 53 ||

pratah-kale shashi yena — like the moon at dawn; malina-badana — with pale face; navina-meghera yena — as of a fresh cloud; gambhira garjana — deep thunder

53His face was pale, like the moon at dawn;
[His voice] like the deep thunder of a fresh cloud.

মায়েরে কহিল প্রভু শুন মোর কথা ।
কি লাগিয়া এতদূর তোর মন-ব্যথা ॥ ৫৪ ॥

māẏere kahila prabhu śuna mora kathā |
ki lāgiẏā etadūra tora mana-byathā || 54 ||

mayere kahila prabhu — the Lord said to His mother; shuna mora katha — listen to My words; ki lagiya — why; etadura — so great; tora mana-vyatha — the pain in your heart

54The Lord said to His mother: "Listen to what I say:
why is there such pain in your heart?

কোন্ ধন নাহি তোর কিবা পাইলে দুঃখ ।
দীন একাকিনী হেন কহ অতি রূখ ॥ ৫৫ ॥

kon dhana nāhi tora kibā pāile duḥkha |
dīna ekākinī hena kaha ati rūkha || 55 ||

kon dhana nahi tora — what wealth do you lack; kiba paile duhkha — what sorrow has befallen you; dina ekakini hena — as if poor and alone; kaha ati rukha — you speak so bitterly

55What wealth do you lack? What sorrow has befallen you?
You speak so bitterly, as if you were poor and alone.

পিতা-অদর্শন মোর স্মরাইলে তুমি ।
যেমন করিছে হিয়া কি কহিব আমি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

pitā-adarśana mora smarāile tumi |
yemana kariche hiẏā ki kahiba āmi || 56 ||

pita-adarshana mora — My no longer seeing My father; smaraile tumi — you have reminded Me of; yemana karichhe hiya — how My heart feels; ki kahiba ami — how can I tell

56You have reminded Me that I no longer see My father —
and how My heart feels, how can I tell?

একজনে দুবার দেহ গুবাক চন্দন ।
নানা দ্রব্য দেহ তোমার যত লয় মন ॥ ৫৭ ॥

ekajane dubāra deha gubāka candana |
nānā drabya deha tomāra yata laẏa mana || 57 ||

eka-jane dubara deha — give each one twice; guvaka chandana — betel and sandal; nana dravya deha — give all kinds of gifts; tomara yata laya mana — as much as your heart wishes

57Give each person betel and sandal twice over,
give all kinds of gifts — as much as your heart desires.

সর্বাঙ্গে লেপহ সভার গন্ধ-চন্দনে ।
যথেষ্ট করিয়া দেহ চিন্তা নাহি মনে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

sarbāṅge lepaha sabhāra gandha-candane |
yatheṣṭa kariẏā deha cintā nāhi mane || 58 ||

sarvange lepaha sabhara — anoint everyone's whole body; gandha-chandane — with fragrant sandal; yatheshta kariya deha — give abundantly; chinta nahi mane — have no worry

58Anoint everyone's whole body with fragrant sandal;
give abundantly, have no worry in your mind.

পৃথিবীতে কেহ যাহা নাহি করে লোকে ।
ইঙ্গিতে করিব তাহা কহিল তোমাকে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

pṛthibīte keha yāhā nāhi kare loke |
iṅgite kariba tāhā kahila tomāke || 59 ||

prithivite keha yaha — what no one on earth; nahi kare loke — does for people; ingite kariba taha — I shall do by a mere sign; kahila tomake — I tell you

59What no one on earth does for people,
I shall accomplish by a mere sign — I tell you."8

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী কহে ধীরে ধীরে ।
মধুর-বচনে শান্ত করি বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৬০ ॥

e bola śuniñā śacī kahe dhīre dhīre |
madhura-bacane śānta kari biśbambhare || 60 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; shachi kahe dhire dhire — Shachi speaks softly; madhura-bachane — with sweet words; shanta kari vishvambhare — calming Vishvambhara

60Hearing these words, Shachi spoke very softly
and with sweet words calmed Vishvambhara.

যেন রূপে আদেশ করিল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
তেন রূপে তুষিল সে ব্রাহ্মণ-সকল ॥ ৬১ ॥

yena rūpe ādeśa karila biśbambhara |
tena rūpe tuṣila se brāhmaṇa-sakala || 61 ||

yena rupe — just as; adesha karila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara directed; tena rupe — so; tushila se — she satisfied; brahmana-sakala — all the brahmanas

61Just as Vishvambhara had directed,
so she satisfied all the brahmanas.

হেনকালে বল্লভ-আচার্য নিজঘরে ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-সহিতে দেব-পিতৃপূজা করে ॥ ৬২ ॥

henakāle ballabha-ācārya nijaghare |
brāhmaṇa-sahite deba-pitṛpūjā kare || 62 ||

hena-kale — meanwhile; vallabha-acharya nija-ghare — Vallabha Acharya in his house; brahmana-sahite — with brahmanas; deva-pitri-puja kare — worships gods and ancestors

62Meanwhile Vallabha Acharya in his own house
worships the gods and ancestors together with brahmanas.

আপন কন্যারে নানা আভরণ দিল ।
গন্ধ-চন্দন-মাল্যে সুবেশ করিল ॥ ৬৩ ॥

āpana kanyāre nānā ābharaṇa dila |
gandha-candana-mālye subeśa karila || 63 ||

apana kanyare — to his daughter; nana abharana dila — gave all kinds of ornaments; gandha-chandana-malye — with scents, sandal, garlands; subesha karila — adorned her

63To his daughter he gave all kinds of ornaments
and adorned her with scents, sandal and garlands.

শুভক্ষণ নিকট বুঝিয়া দ্বিজবর ।
ব্রাহ্মণ পাঠাঞা দিল আনিবারে বর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

śubhakṣaṇa nikaṭa bujhiẏā dbijabara |
brāhmaṇa pāṭhāñā dila ānibāre bara || 64 ||

shubha-kshana nikata bujhiya — seeing the auspicious moment near; dvijabara — the best of brahmanas; brahmana pathana dila — sent a brahmana; anibare bara — to fetch the bridegroom

64Seeing that the auspicious moment was near, the best of brahmanas
sent a brahmana to fetch the bridegroom.

এথা বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ বয়স্যের সঙ্গে ।
অতি অদভুত বেশ করেন শ্রীঅঙ্গে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

ethā biśbambhara pahuṁ baẏasyera saṅge |
ati adabhuta beśa karena śrīaṅge || 65 ||

etha — here; vishvambhara pahun — the Lord Vishvambhara; vayasyera sange — with His friends; ati adabhuta besha — wonderful attire; karena sri-ange — puts on His divine body

65Here, meanwhile, the Lord Vishvambhara, with His friends,
arrays His divine body in wonderful attire.

গন্ধ-চন্দনে অঙ্গ করিল লেপন ।
ললাটে তিলক যেন চাঁদের কিরণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

gandha-candane aṅga karila lepana |
lalāṭe tilaka yena cāṁdera kiraṇa || 66 ||

gandha-chandane — with scents and sandal; anga karila lepana — anointed the body; lalate tilaka — tilaka on the forehead; yena chandera kirana — like a moonbeam

66His body was anointed with scents and sandal;
on His forehead a tilaka like a moonbeam.

মকর-কুণ্ডল গণ্ডে করে ঝলমল ।
মুকুতার হার শোভে হৃদয়-উপর ॥ ৬৭ ॥

makara-kuṇḍala gaṇḍe kare jhalamala |
mukutāra hāra śobhe hṛdaẏa-upara || 67 ||

makara-kundala — makara earrings; gande kare jhalamala — sparkle on the cheeks; mukutara hara — pearl necklace; shobhe hridaya-upara — shines on the chest

67On His cheeks sparkle makara-shaped earrings;
on His chest shines a pearl necklace.

কাজরে উজোর রাতা কমল-নয়ান ।
ভুরুযুগ যেন দুই কামের কামান ॥ ৬৮ ॥

kājare ujora rātā kamala-naẏāna |
bhuruyuga yena dui kāmera kāmāna || 68 ||

kajare ujora — brightened with kajal; rata kamala-nayana — red lotus eyes; bhuru-yuga — the pair of brows; yena dui kamera kamana — like the two bows of Kama

68His red lotus eyes are brightly lined with kajal;
His two brows are like the two bows of Kama.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ দিব্য রতন-অঙ্গুরী ।
ঝলমল দিব্য তেজ চাহিতে না পারি ॥ ৬৯ ॥

aṅgada kaṅkaṇa dibya ratana-aṅgurī |
jhalamala dibya teja cāhite nā pāri || 69 ||

angada kankana — armlets and bracelets; divya ratana-anguri — divine jewelled rings; jhalamala divya teja — a divine radiance sparkles; chahite na pari — one cannot look

69Armlets, bracelets, divine rings set with jewels;
a divine radiance sparkles — one cannot look at it.

দিব্যমালা পরিধান রক্তপ্রান্ত বাস ।
গন্ধে মহ-মহ করে অঙ্গের বাতাস ॥ ৭০ ॥

dibyamālā paridhāna raktaprānta bāsa |
gandhe maha-maha kare aṅgera bātāsa || 70 ||

divya-mala — a divine garland; paridhana rakta-pranta basa — wearing a red-bordered cloth; gandhe maha-maha kare — is laden with fragrance; angera batasa — the breeze from the body

70He wears a divine garland and a cloth with a red border;
the breeze from His body is laden with fragrance.

স্বর্ণ-দর্পণ করে যেন পূর্ণচন্দ্র ।
হেরি লোক নিজ হিয়া না হয় স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৭১ ॥

sbarṇa-darpaṇa kare yena pūrṇacandra |
heri loka nija hiẏā nā haẏa sbatantra || 71 ||

svarna-darpana kare — a golden mirror in the hand; yena purnachandra — like the full moon; heri loka — seeing [Him], people; nija hiya na haya svatantra — are no longer masters of their hearts

71In His hand a golden mirror, like the full moon;
seeing Him, people are no longer masters of their hearts.

বধূগণ বিকল হইল রূপ দেখি ।
রূপ দেখি নারী না নিয়ড় করে আঁখি ॥ ৭২ ॥

badhūgaṇa bikala haila rūpa dekhi |
rūpa dekhi nārī nā niẏaṛa kare āṁkhi || 72 ||

badhu-gana — the young wives; vikala haila — lost composure; rupa dekhi — seeing the beauty; nari — the women; na niyada kare ankhi — cannot take their eyes away

72The young wives lost their composure seeing His beauty;
seeing His beauty, the women cannot take their eyes away.

অথির নারীগণ শিথিল বসন ।
মথিল ভুজঙ্গকুল খগেন্দ্র যেমন ॥ ৭২+১ ॥

athira nārīgaṇa śithila basana |
mathila bhujaṅgakula khagendra yemana || 72+1 ||

athira nari-gana — the women restless; shithila vasana — garments loosened; mathila — crushed (churned); bhujanga-kula — the race of serpents; khagendra yemana — as the king of birds (Garuda)

72+1The women are restless, their garments loosened:
He crushed [their hearts] as the king of birds crushes the race of serpents.9

চিত্ত হরিয়া নিল সভার একই কালে ।
মন-মীন ধরিয়া রাখিল রূপ-জালে ॥ ৭২+২ ॥

citta hariẏā nila sabhāra ekai kāle |
mana-mīna dhariẏā rākhila rūpa-jāle || 72+2 ||

chitta hariya nila — stole the hearts; sabhara — of all; eki kale — at one moment; mana-mina dhariya — catching the fish of the mind; rakhila — holds [it]; rupa-jale — in the net of beauty

72+2At one and the same moment He stole the hearts of all,
caught the fish of their minds and holds it in the net of His beauty.

হরিণীনয়নীগণ গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিয়া ।
বলিতে না পারে সে ধরিতে নারে হিয়া ॥ ৭২+৩ ॥

hariṇīnaẏanīgaṇa gaurāṅga dekhiẏā |
balite nā pāre se dharite nāre hiẏā || 72+3 ||

harini-nayani-gana — the doe-eyed women; gauranga dekhiya — seeing Gauranga; balite na pare se — cannot speak; dharite nare hiya — cannot hold back the heart

72+3The doe-eyed women, gazing at Gauranga,
cannot utter a word, nor hold back their hearts.

ভুরুভঙ্গি-আকর্ষণে রঙ্গিণীর গণ ।
দোলমান হৃদয় করয়ে অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৭২+৪ ॥

bhurubhaṅgi-ākarṣaṇe raṅgiṇīra gaṇa |
dolamāna hṛdaẏa karaẏe anukṣaṇa || 72+4 ||

bhurubhangi-akarshane — drawn by the play of the brows; ranginira gana — the playful women; dolamana hridaya karaye — the heart sways; anukshana — every moment

72+4Drawn by the play of His brows, the playful women
feel their hearts swaying every moment.

সে হাস্য-মাধুরী যার পশিল হিয়ায় ।
মরমে মরিল সেই মদন-ব্যথায় ॥ ৭২+৫ ॥

se hāsya-mādhurī yāra paśila hiẏāẏa |
marame marila sei madana-byathāẏa || 72+5 ||

se hasya-madhuri — that sweetness of the smile; yara pashila hiyaya — into whose heart entered; marame — deep within; marila sei — she swoons (lit. "died"); madana-vyathaya — from the pain of Madana

72+5She into whose heart the sweetness of His smile has entered
swoons deep within from the pain of Madana.

সে ভুজ-বিলাস-রস পরশ লাগিয়া ।
মানিনীর মানগণ চলে লুকাইয়া ॥ ৭২+৬ ॥

se bhuja-bilāsa-rasa paraśa lāgiẏā |
māninīra mānagaṇa cale lukāiẏā || 72+6 ||

se bhuja-vilasa-rasa — the rasa of the play of those arms; parasha lagiya — for the touch; maninira mana-gana — the pride of the proud beauties; chale lukaiya — goes into hiding

72+6Longing to touch the rasa of the play of His arms,
the pride of the proud beauties slinks away into hiding.

মায়ে নমস্করি প্রভু চলে শুভক্ষণে ।
উঠিল মঙ্গলধ্বনি জয় হরিনামে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

māẏe namaskari prabhu cale śubhakṣaṇe |
uṭhila maṅgaladhbani jaẏa harināme || 73 ||

maye namaskari — bowing to His mother; prabhu chale shubha-kshane — the Lord sets out at the auspicious moment; uthila mangala-dhvani — auspicious cries arose; jaya hariname — "Jaya!" and Hari's name

73Bowing to His mother, the Lord sets out at the auspicious moment;
auspicious cries arose — "Jaya!" and the name of Hari.

দিব্য-যানে চড়ে প্রভু বয়স্য-বেষ্টিত ।
সম্মুখে নাটুয়া নাচে গায়নে গায় গীত ॥ ৭৪ ॥

dibya-yāne caṛe prabhu baẏasya-beṣṭita |
sammukhe nāṭuẏā nāce gāẏane gāẏa gīta || 74 ||

divya-yane chade prabhu — the Lord mounts a divine palanquin; vayasya-veshtita — surrounded by friends; sammukhe natuya nache — in front dancers dance; gayane gaya gita — singers sing songs

74The Lord mounts a divine palanquin, surrounded by His friends;
in front dancers dance and singers sing songs.10

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পঢ়ে ভাটে রায়বার ।
শিঙ্গা বরগো বাজে ভেউর কাহাল ॥ ৭৫ ॥

brāhmaṇete beda paṛhe bhāṭe rāẏabāra |
śiṅgā barago bāje bheura kāhāla || 75 ||

brahmanete veda padhe — brahmanas recite the Vedas; bhate rayabara — bards their panegyrics; shinga bargo baje — shinga and bargo horns sound; bheura kahala — bheur and kahal

75Brahmanas recite the Vedas, bards their panegyrics;
shinga and bargo horns sound, bheur and kahal horns.

দামামা দগড় বাজে পটাহ মৃদঙ্গ ।
দোসরি মোহরি বাজে শুনিতে আনন্দ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

dāmāmā dagaṛa bāje paṭāha mṛdaṅga |
dosari mohari bāje śunite ānanda || 76 ||

damama dagada baje — damama and dagar kettledrums sound; pataha mridanga — patahas and mridangas; dosari mohari baje — dosari and mohari pipes play; shunite ananda — a joy to hear

76Damama and dagar kettledrums sound, pataha drums and mridangas;
dosari and mohari pipes play — a joy to hear.11

হরি-হরিবোল শুনি জয়জয়-নাদ ।
আনন্দে নদীয়ার লোক ভেল উন্মাদ ॥ ৭৭ ॥

hari-haribola śuni jaẏajaẏa-nāda |
ānande nadīẏāra loka bhela unmāda || 77 ||

hari-haribola shuni — hearing "Hari, Haribol!"; jayajaya-nada — the cries of "Jaya, jaya!"; anande — with joy; nadiyara loka — the people of Nadia; bhela unmada — went mad

77Hearing "Hari, Haribol!" and the cries of "Jaya, jaya!",
the people of Nadia went mad with joy.

ঠেলাঠেলি ধায় লোক পথ নাহি পায় ।
চমক লাগিল নাগরিকের সভায় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

ṭhelāṭheli dhāẏa loka patha nāhi pāẏa |
camaka lāgila nāgarikera sabhāẏa || 78 ||

thelatheli dhaya loka — people run jostling; patha nahi paya — find no way; chamaka lagila — a thrill ran through; nagarikera sabhaya — the assembly of townsfolk

78People run, jostling one another, unable to find a way;
a thrill ran through the assembly of townsfolk.

কেহ কেশ নাহি বান্ধে না সম্বরে বাস ।
দেখিবারে ধাওয়াধাই ঘন বহে শ্বাস ॥ ৭৯ ॥

keha keśa nāhi bāndhe nā sambare bāsa |
dekhibāre dhāoẏādhāi ghana bahe śbāsa || 79 ||

keha kesha nahi bandhe — some do not tie their hair; na samvare basa — do not adjust their clothes; dekhibare dhaoyadhai — run headlong to see; ghana bahe shvasa — breathing hard

79Some do not tie up their hair, do not adjust their clothes —
they run headlong to see, breathing hard.

কাণাকাণি সানাসানি নাহি আর লাজ ।
ডাকাডাকি ধায় সব নদীয়া-সমাজ ॥ ৮০ ॥

kāṇākāṇi sānāsāni nāhi āra lāja |
ḍākāḍāki dhāẏa saba nadīẏā-samāja || 80 ||

kanakani — whispering; sanasani — exchanging glances; nahi ara laja — with no more shame; dakadaki — calling to one another; dhaya saba nadiya-samaja — all the people of Nadia run

80Whispering, exchanging glances, with no more shame,
calling to one another, all the people of Nadia run.

গরবী গরব সব দূরে তেয়াগিয়া ।
গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিতে ধায় উলসিত হঞা ॥ ৮১ ॥

garabī garaba saba dūre teẏāgiẏā |
gaurāṅga dekhite dhāẏa ulasita hañā || 81 ||

garabi — the proud ones; garaba saba dure teyagiya — casting off all pride; gauranga dekhite dhaya — run to see Gauranga; ulasita hina — joyfully

81The proud ones, casting all their pride far away,
run joyfully to see Gauranga.

পথ বিপথ কেহো না মানে রঙ্গিণী ।
অনঙ্গ-তরঙ্গে সব ধাইল রমণী ॥ ৮১+১ ॥

patha bipatha keho nā māne raṅgiṇī |
anaṅga-taraṅge saba dhāila ramaṇī || 81+1 ||

patha vipatha — road and roadless ground; keho na mane — none heeds; rangini — the playful [women]; ananga-tarange — on the waves of Ananga; saba dhaila ramani — all the women ran

81+1The playful women heed neither road nor roadless ground:
on the waves of Ananga all the women run.12

অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ দিব্য-যানে চাহে ।
গোরা-অঙ্গ দেখিবারে অনুরাগে ধায়ে ॥ ৮২ ॥

antarīkṣe debagaṇa dibya-yāne cāhe |
gorā-aṅga dekhibāre anurāge dhāẏe || 82 ||

antarikshe — in the sky; deva-gana — the gods; divya-yane chahe — look from divine chariots; gora-anga dekhibare — to see Gora's body; anurage dhaye — press forward with love

82In the sky the gods on divine chariots look down
and with love press forward to see Gora's body.

সুরবধূগণ বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ চাহে ।
চতুর্দিকে দিব্য নারী মঙ্গল গায়ে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

surabadhūgaṇa biśbambhara-mukha cāhe |
caturdike dibya nārī maṅgala gāẏe || 83 ||

sura-badhu-gana — the wives of the gods; vishvambhara-mukha chahe — gaze at Vishvambhara's face; chaturdike — on all sides; divya nari — celestial women; mangala gaye — sing auspicious songs

83The wives of the gods gaze at Vishvambhara's face;
on all sides celestial women sing auspicious songs.

Raga bihagara; refrain: "On all sides cries of 'Jaya, jaya!' are heard — the wedding of Gauranga-chand! The respectable wives together raise the 'ulu-ulu': sing auspicious songs with joy!"

কেশ বেশ কর, পাটশাড়ী পর,
কাজর দেহ নয়ানে ।
শ্রীবিশ্বম্ভর-বিহা, সবজন মেলি,
সাজিয়া করল পয়ানে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

keśa beśa kara, pāṭaśāṛī para,
kājara deha naẏāne |
śrībiśbambhara-bihā, sabajana meli,
sājiẏā karala paẏāne || 84 ||

kesha besha kara — do up your hair; patashadi para — put on silk saris; kajara deha nayane — put kajal on your eyes; sri-vishvambhara-biha — to Sri Vishvambhara's wedding; sabajana meli — all gathering; sajiya karala payane — dressed up, they set out

84"Do up your hair, put on silk saris,
put kajal on your eyes!"
To the wedding of Sri Vishvambhara, all gathering together,
dressed up, they set out.

হার কেয়ূর, কঙ্কণ কিঙ্কিণী,
নূপুর পরহ না ঝাট ।
অলকা নিকটে, সিন্দূর ললাটে,
চন্দন-বিন্দু তার হেঠ ॥ ৮৫ ॥

hāra keẏūra, kaṅkaṇa kiṅkiṇī,
nūpura paraha nā jhāṭa |
alakā nikaṭe, sindūra lalāṭe,
candana-bindu tāra heṭha || 85 ||

hara keyura — necklaces, armlets; kankana kinkini — bracelets, belts with bells; nupura — anklets; paraha na jhata — put on quickly; alaka nikate — near the locks; sindura lalate — sindura on the forehead; chandana-bindu tara hetha — a dot of sandal beneath it

85"Necklaces, armlets, bracelets, belts with little bells,
anklets — put them on quickly!"
Sindura on the forehead close to the locks,
and below it a dot of sandal.

তাম্বূল অধরে, তাম্বূল বাম করে,
লীলায় ঢুলি ঢুলি যায় ।
দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর, যেন পাঁচশর,
ধৈরয ধরিতে না পায় ॥ ৮৬ ॥

tāmbūla adhare, tāmbūla bāma kare,
līlāẏa ḍhuli ḍhuli yāẏa |
dekhi biśbambhara, yena pāṁcaśara,
dhairaya dharite nā pāẏa || 86 ||

tambula adhare — betel on the lips; tambula bama kare — betel in the left hand; lilaya dhuli dhuli yaya — they go playfully swaying; dekhi vishvambhara — seeing Vishvambhara; yena panchashara — like the Five-arrowed One (Kama); dhairaya dharite na paya — cannot keep composure

86Betel on their lips, betel in the left hand,
they go playfully swaying;
seeing Vishvambhara, like the Five-arrowed One,13
they cannot keep their composure.

তাম্বূল-চর্বণে, হাসিয়া বয়ানে,
কুন্দ-দশন বিকসি ।
বান্ধুলি-অধরে, দশন-মধুকরে,
পাশে মধুলোভে বসি ॥ ৮৬+১ ॥

tāmbūla-carbaṇe, hāsiẏā baẏāne,
kunda-daśana bikasi |
bāndhuli-adhare, daśana-madhukare,
pāśe madhulobhe basi || 86+1 ||

tambula-charvane — chewing betel; hasiya bayane — with smiling faces; kunda-dashana vikasi — the kunda-bud teeth open; bandhuli-adhare — by the bandhuli-red lips; dashana-madhukare — the bee-like teeth; pashe — close by; madhu-lobhe basi — sit, greedy for honey

86+1Chewing betel, smiling,
their teeth open like buds of kunda jasmine;
by lips red as bandhuli flowers the bee-like teeth
sit close, greedy for honey.14

নাগরী সারি সারি, চলিলা কুতূহলী,
মরাল-গমন সুঠাম ।
মদনরস সব, বিথার অন্তরে,
থির বিশাল নয়ান ॥ ৮৬+২ ॥

nāgarī sāri sāri, calilā kutūhalī,
marāla-gamana suṭhāma |
madanarasa saba, bithāra antare,
thira biśāla naẏāna || 86+2 ||

nagari sari sari — the nagaris in rows; chalila kutuhali — went eagerly; marala-gamana sutham — with the graceful gait of swans; madana-rasa saba — all the rasa of Madana; vithara antare — spreads in the heart; thira vishala nayana — the wide eyes fixed

86+2In rows upon rows the nagaris
went eagerly with the graceful gait of swans;
all the rasa of Madana spreads through their hearts,
their wide eyes stay fixed.

নানা বাদ্য বাজে, শত শঙ্খ গাজে,
মৃদঙ্গ পটাহ কাহাল ।
আনন্দে দুন্দুভি, বাজয়ে ডিণ্ডিমি,
মুহরি বাজয়ে রসাল ॥ ৮৭ ॥

nānā bādya bāje, śata śaṅkha gāje,
mṛdaṅga paṭāha kāhāla |
ānande dundubhi, bājaẏe ḍiṇḍimi,
muhari bājaẏe rasāla || 87 ||

nana vadya baje — all kinds of instruments sound; shata shankha gaje — hundreds of conchs resound; mridanga pataha kahala — mridangas, patahas, kahals; anande dundubhi — joyfully the dundubhis; bajaye dindimi — the dindimas sound; muhari bajaye rasala — the muharis play sweetly

87All kinds of instruments sound, hundreds of conchs resound,
mridangas, pataha drums and kahal horns;
joyfully the dundubhis sound and the dindima drums,
sweetly the muhari pipes play.

বীণার বিলাস, বেণু মন্দভাষ,
রবাব উপাঙ্গ পাখোয়াজে ।
নদীয়া-নগরে, আনন্দ ঘরে ঘরে,
মঙ্গল-বাধাই বাজে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

bīṇāra bilāsa, beṇu mandabhāṣa,
rabāba upāṅga pākhoẏāje |
nadīẏā-nagare, ānanda ghare ghare,
maṅgala-bādhāi bāje || 88 ||

vinara vilasa — the play of vinas; venu mandabhasha — flutes softly speak; rababa upanga pakhoyaje — rababs, upangas, pakhoyajs; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; ananda ghare ghare — joy in every house; mangala-badhai baje — auspicious wedding music plays

88The vinas play, the flutes softly speak,
rababs, upangas, pakhoyajs;
in the town of Nadia there is joy in every house,
auspicious wedding music plays.

গৌরচন্দ্র-মুখ, দেখি সব লোক,
আনন্দ নদীয়া-সমাজ ।
কোটি কাম জিনি, সে রূপ বাখানি,
নিরখি না রহে লাজ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

gauracandra-mukha, dekhi saba loka,
ānanda nadīẏā-samāja |
koṭi kāma jini, se rūpa bākhāni,
nirakhi nā rahe lāja || 89 ||

gaurachandra-mukha — Gaurachandra's face; dekhi saba loka — all people see; ananda nadiya-samaja — the people of Nadia rejoice; koti kama jini — surpassing millions of Kamas; se rupa bakhani — praising that beauty; nirakhi na rahe laja — gazing, they lose all shame

89All the people gaze at Gaurachandra's face,
all the people of Nadia rejoice;
praising that beauty which surpasses millions of Kamadevas,
they gaze at Him, forgetting all shame.

ফুয়ল কবরী, চীর না সম্বরি,
ধায়ে উনমত-বেশ ।
পাসরি পতি-সুত, বদন সুবেকত,
হিয়া-পরি ফেলে কেশ ॥ ৯০ ॥

phuẏala kabarī, cīra nā sambari,
dhāẏe unamata-beśa |
pāsari pati-suta, badana subekata,
hiẏā-pari phele keśa || 90 ||

phuyala kabari — braids loosened; chira na samvari — not adjusting their clothes; dhaye unamata-besha — they run in a frenzy; pasari pati-suta — forgetting husbands and sons; badana subekata — faces uncovered; hiya-pari phele kesha — hair falling on their breasts

90Braids come loose, garments go unadjusted —
they run in a frenzy;
forgetting husbands and sons, faces uncovered,
their hair falling over their breasts.

ধনি ধনি ধনি, কহয়ে রমণী,
আন না শুনিয়ে বাণী ।
চৌদিকে হাটে-বাটে, নাগরীর ঠাটে,
দেখিতে করল উঠানি ॥ ৯১ ॥

dhani dhani dhani, kahaẏe ramaṇī,
āna nā śuniẏe bāṇī |
caudike hāṭe-bāṭe, nāgarīra ṭhāṭe,
dekhite karala uṭhāni || 91 ||

dhani dhani dhani — "Blessed, blessed, blessed!"; kahaye ramani — say the women; ana na shuniye vani — no other word is heard; chaudike hate-bate — on all sides in markets and roads; nagarira thate — in crowds of nagaris; dekhite karala uthani — rose up to see

91"Blessed, blessed, blessed!" say the women,
no other word is heard;
on all sides, in markets and roads, crowds of nagaris
rose up to see.

কেহ বীণা বায়, কেহ গীত গায়,
কেহ ধায় উল্লাসে ।
চৌদিকে জয় জয়, মঙ্গল বিজয়,
কহয়ে লোচনদাসে ॥ ৯২ ॥

keha bīṇā bāẏa, keha gīta gāẏa,
keha dhāẏa ullāse |
caudike jaẏa jaẏa, maṅgala bijaẏa,
kahaẏe locanadāse || 92 ||

keha vina baya — some play the vina; keha gita gaya — some sing songs; keha dhaya ullase — some run in delight; chaudike jaya jaya — on all sides "Jaya, jaya!"; mangala vijaya — the auspicious triumph; kahaye lochana-dase — says Lochana Dasa

92Some play the vina, some sing songs,
some run in delight;
on all sides "Jaya, jaya!", the auspicious triumph —
so says Lochana Dasa.

✦

Notes

  1. The fetching of water (jal-saha; in Lochana Dasa "pani sahi"): on the morning of the wedding the married women go singing to the Ganga to fetch water for the bridegroom's bath (below, vv. 17–33).
  2. Kushandika is the rite at the sacred fire that concludes the wedding (in Lochana Dasa, on the day after the wedding).
  3. "Aiho-suho" are married women whose husbands are living: only they take part in the auspicious wedding rites.
  4. "Pani sahi" — see note 1.
  5. Here and below (vv. 18–33, 72, 78–81, 84–92) is a favourite motif of Lochana Dasa: the women of Nadia, forgetting shame, are drawn to Gaura (nagari-bhava; see en/09, note 9). Still more such lines are in the 1983 edition (vv. 40+1 – 40+9, 72+1 – 72+6, 81+1, 86+1 – 86+2); they are absent in A.
  6. Vv. 40+1 – 40+9 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets (except v. 40+8) — the way that editor marks lines found in only some manuscripts. This is Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see note 5 and en/09, note 9). "Madana" (Kamadeva) here is an image of the hearts' attraction to Gaura; for a Gaudiya Vaishnava the Lord is the transcendental (aprakrita) Madana, and such attraction to Him, as in the gopis, is not worldly passion; Bhaktisiddhanta, however, does not accept worship of Gaura in the mood of "Gaura-nagari". "Forgot even the duty of a faithful wife" (v. 40+7) — like the gopis, who left family dharma for Krishna's sake.
  7. By custom a widow takes no part in the auspicious wedding rites and cannot honour the guests as before; hence Shachi's grief. Cf. Murari 1.10.5–12.
  8. That is, the Lord, encouraging His mother, promises to do for the guests by His mere sign more than people can; cf. Murari (1.10.11): "I have the power to do what is beyond mortals, and yet I follow the customs of the world."
  9. Vv. 72+1 – 72+6 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets (together with v. 72). The king of birds is Garuda, the enemy of serpents.
  10. In the 1983 edition there are two couplets instead of this one (a different redaction): "The Lord mounts a divine palanquin, surrounded by His friends; seeing this, all the people rejoice at heart. The Lord sets out with His friends; in front a dancer dances, singers sing." A and the 1903 edition have one couplet; we follow A.
  11. Shinga is a horn; bargo, a wind instrument; damama and dagar, large kettledrums; dosari and mohari (muhari), pipes like the shahnai. For bheur, kahal and the others see the glossary.
  12. V. 81+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has it in brackets (together with v. 81). Ananga ("the Bodiless") is Kamadeva.
  13. The Five-arrowed One is Kamadeva, the god of love, armed with five flower-arrows.
  14. Stanzas 86+1 – 86+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets. Bandhuli (bandhuka) is a bright red flower, a usual simile for lips.
